about_the_game:
Overview

HEMOHOUND is a single player fast-paced FPS set in a western desert during the early 1900s where vampires stand under the sun and seek to find immortality. Traverse through desertic towns corroded by decaying hematophages seeking to stop you from reaching the primearch's resting grounds, blast your way through vampire hordes by drinking their blood to quench your thirst and steal their essence.

VAMPIRES FEED ON EACH OTHER ON A DESPERATE BLOOD RUSH WEST

Grayhill town marked as the fiends' parting point.

Is disease the motif of this uproar?

Bodies pile up across East Dayle.

A mysterious disease seems to be spreading across the vampire masses stripping them of their resistance to the sun's rays. These afflicted creatures drop dead suddenly appearing to rot from the inside. Investigations point that their sudden rush west indicates the possible presence of a cure most likely in the unknown Fidlands.

Features:

  • Roguelike experience in a fast-paced Boomer Shooter setting

  • Charge up your Blood Meter and unleash brutish carnage 

  • Perform Impalaxis on weakened enemies to heal and fill the Blood Meter faster

  • Strategic routing through randomized western routes each run

  • Varied weapons to gun dead your kin

  • Powerful upgrades and sinergies to thrive in the Blood Rush

  • Stage modifiers such as explosive barrels and environmental hazards

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of explicit violence and gore.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500 or AMD FX 6350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: HEMOHOUND is a fast-paced western shooter with roguelike elements in a world where vampires stand under the sun. Consume your foes' blood to gain their skills and weapons as you cut a bloody trail through the west seeking to become worthy of immortality.
